meta.concept:
Under the cover of a heavy thunderstorm in **vinewood**, night has fallen and rain lashes against the streets surrounding a guarded mansion compound where a high-profile dealer is holding court atop an illegal penthouse balcony overlooking the hills. A silent security guard stands watch at the main entrance, unaware that a corrupt officer stationed nearby is tracking the operation from his patrol car parked on the highway exit near **downtown**. The protagonist needs to infiltrate this location without alerting either faction or compromising the sensitive intel being broadcast during the event below, requiring absolute silence as they move through the stormy streets.

The mission begins with the player entering the perimeter at street level, where the objective is strictly avoidance rather than combat since climbing the exposed fire escape would be spotted instantly by the guard’s patrol tower. Instead of risking detection while scaling the side of the building, the player must trigger a specialized grappling rig concealed on their belt to instantaneously haul them from ground level straight onto the rooftop tiles. Once airborne, they navigate across the wet roof and wedge the listening device into the vent just as the corrupt officer drives past in his vehicle, ensuring the party remains unaware of the intrusion while maintaining total silence above to secure the intel drop.
meta.user_prompt:
A rooftop infiltration above the Vinewood hills. The player starts on the street
outside a guarded mansion and needs to reach a penthouse balcony overlooking the
party below to plant a listening device. Climbing up the fire escape in full view
of the guards would blow the whole job, so the player instead uses a grappling
rig that instantly hauls them from street level straight up onto the rooftop the
moment they trigger it.
